445832.findings: Louisa Anne Meredith, 'Our Island Home: A Tasmanian Sketch Book', gilt and black decorated cloth, title on cover and spine. This title was published in London (Marcus Ward) in 1879 and had only the one edition. Photos show the large autotype plates with printed captions: 'Hobart Town, Mt Direction &c, from Proctor's Road', 'South Arm, from the Springs', 'Herne Bay, D'Entrecasteaux's Channel', 'Wine-Glass Bay, Schoutens', 'Cape Raoul'; plates marked 'Autotype' and 'London'. Inside the back board are pasted Hobart newspaper cuttings: The Mercury, Monday July 14, 1930, 'Desire to Fly, Tasmanian Glider, Test at Brighton' (William Wedd and Clyde Halloran's glider 'The Optimist'), 'Two More A Licences' (Halloran), January 19 1933, plus original photos of the glider frame and glider in flight. These add local aviation interest.
445832.condition: Cloth rubbed and faded with spotting and staining; spine ends frayed; plates with some foxing and marks; back pastedown covered in clippings, boards worn at edges; hinges should be checked.
445832.reason: Scarce 1879 Tasmanian illustrated book by Louisa Anne Meredith; at viewing check title page imprint (Marcus Ward, London, 1879), count of plates against the full list, any loose or missing plates, hinges and text block soundness.
445832.marks_read: Cover: Our Island Home, A Tasmanian Sketch Book by Louisa A Meredith; plates: Autotype, London; Mercury 14 July 1930, 19 Jan 1933 clippings
